title.zh: 现货比特币ETF单日净流出4.85亿美元，抹去10月初全部净流入
title.en: Spot Bitcoin ETFs See $485M Single-Day Outflows, Erasing October Net Inflows

summary.zh: 美国现货比特币ETF周三录得4.849亿美元净流出，为6月25日以来最大单日流出，完全抹去10月前四个交易日的3.216亿美元净流入，10月累计转为约1.63亿美元净流出。其中贝莱德IBIT流出2.077亿美元居首。机构资金流入明显降温 (institutional inflows cooling)，与比特币在8.3万美元附近承压的走势相互印证。
summary.en: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs posted $484.9 million in net outflows on Wednesday, the largest single-day withdrawal since June 25, wiping out the $321.6 million in net inflows recorded over October's first four trading sessions and leaving October with about $163 million in net outflows. BlackRock's IBIT led the redemptions at $207.7 million. The pullback signals cooling institutional demand as Bitcoin struggles near $83,000.

title.zh: 24小时爆仓超10.2亿美元，一小时内3.94亿美元杠杆头寸被清算
title.en: Over $1.02B Liquidated in 24 Hours as $394M Wiped Out in a Single Hour

summary.zh: 加密市场杠杆头寸遭遇连环爆仓 (cascade liquidations)，24小时全网爆仓金额超过10.2亿美元，其中一小时内就有3.94亿美元被清算，多单占比3.84亿美元。比特币承受了2.09亿美元的爆仓损失，以太坊为8700万美元。市场情绪指数仍处于62的“贪婪”区间，波动或未结束。
summary.en: Crypto markets suffered cascading liquidations totaling more than $1.02 billion over 24 hours, including $394 million wiped out within a single hour, of which $384 million were long positions. Bitcoin absorbed $209 million of the damage, followed by Ethereum at $87 million. The market sentiment index remains at 62 in 'Greed' territory, suggesting volatility may not be over.

title.zh: 以太坊跌至2560美元附近，现货ETF连续第七个交易日净流出
title.en: Ethereum Falls Toward $2,560 as Spot ETF Outflows Stretch to Seventh Straight Day

summary.zh: 以太坊跟随比特币走弱，价格跌至2560美元附近，跌破区间通道支撑。美国现货以太坊ETF周三净流出1.609亿美元，为连续第七个交易日流出，自9月29日以来累计流出约5.69亿美元，其中贝莱德ETHA占1.161亿美元。部分交易员将2520至2500美元视为下一批关键支撑位。
summary.en: Ethereum followed Bitcoin lower, sliding toward $2,560 and breaking below its range-channel support. U.S. spot Ether ETFs recorded $160.9 million in net outflows on Wednesday, extending the losing streak to seven consecutive trading sessions, with about $569 million withdrawn since September 29 — $116.1 million of it from BlackRock's ETHA. Some traders now watch $2,520–$2,500 as the next key support zone.

title.zh: SOL跌至115美元附近，SOL现货ETF资金流入骤降98.7%
title.en: SOL Slips Near $115 as Spot Solana ETF Inflows Plunge 98.7%

summary.zh: Solana在10月8日交易时段交投于115美元附近，与以太坊同步回调。资金流数据同样转冷：SOL现货ETF资金流入骤降98.7%，尽管链上DEX交易量仍维持在约30.6亿美元。市场等待Alpenglow共识升级 (Alpenglow consensus upgrade) 的主网激活，以验证此前在测试网上实现的毫秒级确认表现。
summary.en: Solana traded near $115 during the October 8 session, pulling back alongside Ethereum. Fund flows also cooled: inflows into spot Solana ETFs plunged 98.7%, even as on-chain DEX volume held around $3.06 billion. The market now awaits mainnet activation of the Alpenglow consensus upgrade to validate the millisecond-level finality demonstrated on testnet.

title.zh: SEC发布代币化股票“创新豁免”：代币化美股可上线链上交易场所
title.en: SEC Issues 'Innovation Exemption' Allowing Tokenized U.S. Stocks on Onchain Venues

summary.zh: 美国证券交易委员会 (SEC) 发布两项为期五年的有条件豁免，允许获许可的代币化美股 (tokenized stocks) 在链上交易场所交易：代币化证券场所 (Tokenized Securities Venues) 可豁免于“交易所”定义，通过自动做市商 (AMM) 和流动性池提供流动性的做市商可豁免于“交易商”定义。豁免设有交易品种与成交量上限，且不覆盖DeFi或代币化基金。
summary.en: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission issued two five-year conditional exemptions allowing permissioned tokenized versions of U.S.-listed stocks to trade on onchain venues: Tokenized Securities Venues are exempted from the definition of an exchange, while liquidity providers supplying liquidity through automated market makers and liquidity pools are exempted from the dealer definition. The relief carries symbol and volume caps and does not cover DeFi or tokenized funds.

title.zh: Bitget约3.88亿美元被盗案追踪：87.8枚BTC已流入混币器
title.en: BitOK Traces 87.8 BTC From Bitget's ~$388M Hack as Stolen Funds Reach Mixers

summary.zh: 区块链取证公司BitOK的资金流报告显示，9月24日Bitget约3.88亿美元被盗案中，已有87.8枚比特币经由特定分支地址进入混币器 (mixers)，调查人员已锁定10个未花费输出。初步报告将攻击归因于第三方安全产品被窃取的凭证 (stolen credentials)，Mandiant也参与了调查。CertiK数据显示9月加密行业损失约7.72亿美元，第三季度累计达12.7亿美元。
summary.en: Blockchain forensics firm BitOK's fund-flow report shows that 87.8 BTC from the roughly $388 million Bitget hack on September 24 has reached mixers via a traced branch of the attack, with investigators pinpointing ten unspent outputs. Preliminary reports attribute the intrusion to credentials stolen through a third-party security product, with Mandiant also involved in the investigation. CertiK data shows industry losses of about $772.4 million in September and $1.27 billion for Q3.

title.zh: 美国财政部发布GENIUS法案州级稳定币认证临时最终规则
title.en: U.S. Treasury Issues Interim Final Rule on State Stablecoin Certifications Under GENIUS Act

summary.zh: 美国财政部发布GENIUS法案 (GENIUS Act) 下首个具约束力的临时最终规则 (interim final rule)，9月30日即时生效：由稳定币认证审查委员会 (Stablecoin Certification Review Committee) 审批各州稳定币监管体制是否“实质相似”于联邦框架。流通量不超过100亿美元的发行人可选择州级监管，而Tether、Circle等超限发行人将被排除在州级路径之外。委员会在获得OMB批准前暂不受理认证申请。
summary.en: The U.S. Treasury published the first binding interim final rule under the GENIUS Act, effective September 30: the Stablecoin Certification Review Committee will approve or deny whether state stablecoin regulatory regimes are 'substantially similar' to the federal framework. Issuers with up to $10 billion in outstanding payment stablecoins may opt for state regulation, while issuers above the cap such as Tether and Circle are effectively excluded from the state pathway. The Committee will not accept certifications until OMB grants information-collection approval.

title.zh: 花旗将比特币12个月目标价上调至11.3万美元，押注ETF资金回流
title.en: Citi Raises 12-Month Bitcoin Target to $113,000, Betting on Returning ETF Flows

summary.zh: 花旗分析师Alex Saunders在10月初的研究报告中，将比特币12个月基准目标价从8.2万美元上调至11.3万美元，以太坊目标价从2240美元上调至3028美元。银行预计未来12个月加密投资产品将吸引约50亿美元净流入 (net inflows)，理由是市场活跃度、宏观环境和ETF资金流三项指标同步改善。这是花旗在2026年连续两次下调后首次上调加密目标价。
summary.en: Citi analyst Alex Saunders raised the bank's 12-month base-case Bitcoin target to $113,000 from $82,000 in an early-October research note, lifting the Ether target to $3,028 from $2,240. The bank now expects roughly $5 billion in net inflows into crypto investment products over the next 12 months, citing improvement across all three of its tracked inputs: market activity, the macro backdrop, and ETF flows. It is Citi's first upgrade after two downgrades earlier in 2026.

Bitcoin fell below $84,000 on Wednesday, touching about $83,550, as total crypto liquidations reached $555.6 million over 24 hours, with $487.2 million from long positions, per CoinGlass. The sell-off followed Iran's escalation of attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz, which pushed Brent crude above $101 a barrel and lifted Treasury yields and the dollar, sparking a risk-off rush. Ether dropped about 3.5% to roughly $2,600, while smaller tokens fell further.
summary.zh: 比特币周三跌破84000美元，最低触及约83550美元，24小时爆仓总额达5.556亿美元 (liquidations)，其中4.872亿美元为多头 (longs)。导火索是伊朗在霍尔木兹海峡 (Strait of Hormuz) 加大对油轮的袭击，布伦特原油 (Brent crude) 冲破每桶101美元，推高美债收益率 (Treasury yields) 与美元，引发避险情绪 (risk-off)。以太坊同步下跌约3.5%至2600美元一线，小市值币种跌幅更深。

title.en: Bitcoin Drops Below $84,000 as Geopolitical Tensions Trigger Over $550M in Liquidations
title.zh: 比特币跌破8.4万美元，地缘紧张引发逾5亿美元爆仓

summary.en: US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $119 million in net inflows on Tuesday, reversing Monday's $90 million loss and marking the fourth inflow day in the last five sessions, according to SoSoValue data. In contrast, spot Ether ETFs posted $202 million in outflows on the same day, extending their outflow streak to six consecutive trading sessions totaling about $408 million. XRP ETFs attracted $3.1 million while Solana ETFs saw $3.7 million in outflows.
summary.zh: 美国现货比特币ETF (Spot Bitcoin ETF) 周二录得1.19亿美元净流入 (net inflows)，扭转了周一9000万美元的流出，为近五个交易日中的第四个流入日。反差鲜明的是，现货以太坊ETF (Spot Ether ETF) 当天流出2.02亿美元，连续第六个交易日失血，累计约4.08亿美元。XRP相关ETF小幅流入310万美元，Solana ETF流出370万美元。

title.en: Spot Bitcoin ETFs Draw $119M Inflows Despite Price Drop as Ether Funds Extend Outflow Streak
title.zh: 现货比特币ETF逆势吸金1.19亿美元，以太坊ETF遭遇六连流出

summary.en: Solana's largest consensus overhaul, Alpenglow, is targeted for October mainnet activation via the Agave 4.3 validator release and is already live on testnet. The upgrade replaces TowerBFT with the Votor engine, cutting transaction finality from roughly 12.8 seconds to about 150 milliseconds, and moves validator vote messages, which currently consume up to 75% of block space, off-chain to free capacity for user transactions. No mainnet activation date has been confirmed yet, and validators must complete BLS key registration and Validator Admission Ticket checks first.
summary.zh: Solana迄今最大的共识机制升级Alpenglow预计于10月随验证器客户端Agave 4.3上线主网 (mainnet)，目前已在测试网上运行。该升级用Votor引擎取代TowerBFT，将交易最终确认 (finality) 时间从约12.8秒压缩至150毫秒左右，并将目前占用高达75%区块空间的验证投票移至链下 (off-chain)，释放更多交易容量。验证者需完成BLS密钥注册并通过验证者准入票 (Validator Admission Ticket) 检查，主网具体激活日期尚未公布。

title.en: Solana's Alpenglow Upgrade Nears, Targeting 150-Millisecond Finality
title.zh: Solana共识大升级Alpenglow临近，目标实现150毫秒最终确认

summary.en: Crypto trader Frogman said two of his wallets were drained of more than $4 million around 4:30 a.m. Singapore time on October 7 while he slept in Singapore ahead of the TOKEN2049 conference. On-chain analysts tracked the stolen tokens (BP, MarsCoin, Cash Cat and others) as they were swapped into ETH, BNB and SOL, then routed through the Privacy Cash privacy protocol and the Chainflip cross-chain swap protocol. Frogman said he does not yet know how the attacker gained access; analysts suggest a compromised seed phrase or device rather than a single token approval.
summary.zh: 加密货币交易员Frogman称，其两个钱包在10月7日凌晨新加坡时间4:30左右被盗走超400万美元资产，当时他正在新加坡参加TOKEN2049会议期间熟睡。链上分析显示，被盗代币 (BP、MarsCoin、Cash Cat等) 被兑换为ETH、BNB和SOL，并经由隐私协议 (Privacy Cash) 与跨链协议 (Chainflip) 转移。Frogman表示尚不清楚攻击者如何得手，分析人士推测可能是助记词 (seed phrase) 或设备被入侵，而非单一代币授权问题。

title.en: Trader Frogman Loses $4M+ in Wallet Hack in Singapore During TOKEN2049
title.zh: 交易员Frogman在新加坡遭黑客攻击，超400万美元钱包资产被盗

summary.en: Ethereum's next major upgrade, Glamsterdam, activated on the Sepolia testnet on October 6 at 13:53 UTC, including 18 core EIPs and seven other EIPs. Headline changes include enshrined proposer-builder separation (ePBS, EIP-7732) and block-level access lists (EIP-7928), alongside a gas limit increase on Sepolia from about 60 million to 200 million to test parallel processing under larger blocks. Developers will use Sepolia results to set the activation schedule for the Hoodi testnet and, eventually, mainnet.
summary.zh: 以太坊下一次重大升级Glamsterdam已于10月6日13:53 UTC在Sepolia测试网 (testnet) 激活，包含18个核心EIP与7个其他EIP。核心内容包括协议内提案者-构建者分离 (ePBS, EIP-7732) 与区块级访问列表 (Block-Level Access Lists, EIP-7928)，并将Sepolia的Gas上限 (gas limit) 从约6000万提升至2亿，以测试网络在更大区块下的并行处理能力。开发者将依据Sepolia表现决定Hoodi测试网与主网 (mainnet) 的激活时间表。

title.en: Ethereum's Glamsterdam Upgrade Goes Live on Sepolia Testnet With 200M Gas Limit Test
title.zh: 以太坊Glamsterdam升级上线Sepolia测试网，测试2亿Gas上限

summary.en: Bitcoin treasury company Strategy (formerly MicroStrategy) disclosed in an October 5 Form 8-K filing that it acquired 334 bitcoin for about $28.7 million between October 1 and 4 at an average price of roughly $85,839, lifting total holdings to 848,000 BTC, more than 4% of Bitcoin's 21 million fixed supply. The company also estimated a third-quarter digital-asset fair-value gain of about $20.91 billion, with a deferred tax expense of roughly $1.88 billion.
summary.zh: 比特币财库公司Strategy (原MicroStrategy) 在10月5日披露的8-K文件中称，于10月1日至4日以约2870万美元购入334枚比特币 (Bitcoin)，均价约85839美元，总持仓升至84.8万枚，超过比特币2100万固定供应量的4%。公司同时预估第三季度数字资产公允价值收益 (fair-value gain) 约209亿美元，递延税费用 (deferred tax expense) 约18.8亿美元。

title.en: Strategy Buys 334 More BTC, Holdings Reach 848,000; Q3 Digital-Asset Gain Hits $20.9B
title.zh: Strategy再购334枚比特币，总持仓达84.8万枚；Q3数字资产浮盈209亿美元

summary.en: Cross-chain swap service NEAR Intents said the roughly $3.8 million stolen in a security breach has been returned in full. The exploit stemmed from a bug in the interaction between its Omni deposit-and-withdrawal infrastructure and the NEAR Intents smart contract, prompting a temporary service pause; blockchain investigator ZachXBT traced the funds to KuCoin, where they were bridged to Bitcoin. General manager Alex Shevchenko had publicly told the attacker the team knew their identity and issued a 48-hour return ultimatum under a responsible-disclosure framework, after which the funds came back in full.
summary.zh: 跨链兑换服务NEAR Intents宣布，被盗的约380万美元资金已全额追回。该漏洞源于Omni存取款基础设施与NEAR Intents智能合约交互中的缺陷 (bug)，团队一度暂停服务；链上侦探ZachXBT追踪到被盗资金被转入KuCoin并桥接为比特币 (Bitcoin)。总经理Alex Shevchenko此前公开表示已锁定攻击者身份，并以“负责任披露” (responsible disclosure) 为名发出48小时归还最后通牒，资金随后被悉数返还。

title.en: NEAR Intents Recovers Entire $3.8M After 48-Hour Ultimatum to Exploiter
title.zh: NEAR Intents遭380万美元攻击后全额追回，曾向攻击者发出48小时最后通牒

summary.en: The US Securities and Exchange Commission voted on October 1 to propose a dedicated crypto custody framework (File No. S7-2026-35), amending rules under the Investment Advisers Act of 1940 and the Investment Company Act of 1940. The 760-page proposal would recognize state-chartered trust companies as qualified custodians, permit registered advisers to self-custody client crypto in limited cases where no permitted custodian is available (with documentation and quarterly reviews), and explicitly excludes crypto exchanges from the qualified-custodian category. A 60-day public comment period opens once the release publishes in the Federal Register.
summary.zh: 美国证券交易委员会 (SEC) 于10月1日投票提议加密资产托管新规 (文件编号S7-2026-35)，修订《投资顾问法》与《投资公司法》相关条款。这是SEC首个针对注册投资顾问 (registered investment advisers) 与受监管基金的专用加密托管框架：州特许信托公司可被认定为合格托管人 (qualified custodian)；在无可用托管机构时，顾问可有限自托管客户加密资产，但需备案并每季度复核；加密交易所被明确排除在合格托管人之列。提案长达760页，将进入60天公众意见征询期。

title.en: SEC Proposes Dedicated Crypto Custody Framework for Advisers and Funds
title.zh: SEC提议加密托管新规：允许顾问有限自托管，州信托公司可担任合格托管人
比特币守住8.6万美元上方，美联储会议纪要今日公布
title.en: Bitcoin Holds Above $86K Ahead of FOMC Minutes Release

summary.zh: 比特币在86000美元附近交投，本周第三次未能突破87000美元阻力位 (resistance)。现货ETF (Spot ETF) 资金流向喜忧参半：上周录得2.41亿美元净流入、连续第三周增长，但单日也曾出现8980万美元流出。美联储 (Fed) 将于今日公布9月会议纪要 (FOMC minutes)，市场关注官员对进一步加息的分歧程度。
summary.en: Bitcoin traded near $86,000 after sellers rejected a move above $87,000 for the third time since late September. Spot ETF flows were mixed: last week brought $241 million in net inflows, the third straight positive week, though one session saw $89.8 million in outflows. The Fed releases its September FOMC minutes today, and traders will parse them for the depth of disagreement over further rate hikes.

title.zh: Strategy再购334枚比特币，总持仓突破84.8万枚
title.en: Strategy Buys 334 More Bitcoin, Holdings Top 848,000 BTC

summary.zh: Strategy在10月1日至4日以约2870万美元购入334枚BTC，均价85,838美元（10月5日披露的SEC 8-K文件）。公司目前持有84.8万枚比特币，总成本约639.7亿美元，平均成本75,441美元。该公司同时估计三季度数字资产收益 (digital-asset gain) 约209亿美元。
summary.en: Strategy acquired 334 BTC for about $28.7 million between October 1 and 4 at an average price of $85,838, per its October 5 SEC 8-K filing. Total holdings reached 848,000 BTC at an aggregate cost of $63.97 billion (average $75,441). The company also estimated a roughly $20.9 billion gain on digital assets for Q3.

title.zh: ZachXBT卧底追踪Bybit被盗资金，捣毁Lazarus关联洗钱网络
title.en: ZachXBT's Undercover Sting Traced Bybit Hack Funds to Lazarus-Linked Network

summary.zh: 链上侦探 (on-chain investigator) ZachXBT披露，他自掏腰包34.97万美元伪装成客户，潜入一个涉嫌为朝鲜Lazarus Group洗钱超10亿美元的华人洗钱网络。该行动帮助追踪了超1200万美元的Bybit被盗资金，Tether随后冻结了44.2万枚USDT。相关调查细节已移交私营调查机构与执法部门。
summary.en: On-chain investigator ZachXBT disclosed that he spent $349,700 posing as a client to infiltrate an alleged Chinese money-laundering network that moved over $1 billion for North Korea-linked hackers. The operation helped trace more than $12 million in funds from Bybit's $1.5 billion theft, and Tether later froze 442,000 USDT. Findings were shared with private-sector investigators and law enforcement.

title.zh: 以太坊完成主网首笔原子化L1到L2跨层交易
title.en: Ethereum Executes First Atomic L1-to-L2 Transaction on Mainnet

summary.zh: 以太坊经济区 (Ethereum Economic Zone, EEZ) 在主网完成首笔原子化跨层交易，以一笔0.001 ETH测试交易演示了L1与L2之间的同步可组合性 (synchronous composability)。该里程碑有望统一流动性、降低对跨链桥 (bridge) 的依赖。ETH维持在2700美元上方交投。
summary.en: The Ethereum Economic Zone (EEZ) completed the first atomic cross-layer transaction on mainnet, demonstrating synchronous composability between L1 and L2 with a 0.001 ETH test transaction. The milestone could unify liquidity and reduce reliance on bridges. ETH held above $2,700.

title.zh: BitMine再购15112枚ETH，总持仓达602万枚
title.en: BitMine Adds 15,112 ETH, Holdings Reach 6.02 Million

summary.zh: BitMine在10月4日当周增持15,112枚ETH（约4100万美元），总持仓达6,016,414枚，相当于ETH供应量的4.9%，距离其5%“炼金术”目标 (alchemy of 5%) 仅一步之遥。公司质押 (staking) 的ETH达507万枚，预计年化质押收入3.63亿美元。
summary.en: BitMine added 15,112 ETH (about $41 million) in the week through October 4, lifting holdings to 6,016,414 tokens — 4.9% of ETH supply, near its self-stated 5% "alchemy" target. The company has 5.07 million ETH staked and projects $363 million in annual staking revenue.

title.zh: NEAR Intents追回380万美元被盗资金，调查结束
title.en: NEAR Intents Recovers $3.8M in Exploit Funds as Probe Ends

summary.zh: 跨链交易平台NEAR Intents确认已全额追回此前攻击中损失的380万美元资金，攻击者于10月2日归还了约34.59枚BTC及部分其他资产。NEAR联创Illia Polosukhin将追回归功于SHIELD AI安全层与快速链上侦查。协议计划下周起逐步恢复暂停的跨链服务。
summary.en: Cross-chain trading platform NEAR Intents confirmed the full $3.8 million stolen in its October 1 exploit has been recovered, with the attacker returning about 34.59 BTC and other assets on October 2. Co-founder Illia Polosukhin credited the SHIELD AI security layer and rapid on-chain detective work. The protocol plans to restore paused cross-chain services starting next week.

title.zh: OKX与ICE合资公司拟推24/7代币化美股交易平台
title.en: OKXICE Files to Launch 24/7 Tokenized U.S. Stock Trading Venue

summary.zh: OKX与纽交所母公司ICE的合资公司OKXICE已通知SEC，计划依据创新豁免 (Innovation Exemption) 推出代币化证券交易场所 (Tokenized Securities Venue)，首批覆盖60多只美股，包括英伟达、苹果、特斯拉等。交易将通过X Layer上的许可制Uniswap v4流动性池进行，全天候 (24/7) 交易；代币持有人享有与普通股东相同的分红与投票权。各发行人有30天异议期。
summary.en: OKXICE, the joint venture between OKX and NYSE parent ICE, notified the SEC of its plan to launch a tokenized U.S. stock trading venue under the five-year Innovation Exemption, initially covering 60+ listed companies including Nvidia, Apple and Tesla. Trading would run 24/7 through permissioned Uniswap v4 pools on X Layer; token holders retain the same dividend and voting rights as ordinary shareholders. Issuers have 30 days to object.

title.zh: CLARITY法案流产后，CFTC单干发布CTX/CAM监管框架征求意见
title.en: CFTC Publishes CTX/CAM Rulemaking Notice After CLARITY Act Failure

summary.zh: 美国商品期货交易委员会 (CFTC) 10月5日发布预先征求意见通知，提出监管框架CTX（加密资产交易监管）与CAM（加密资产市场监管），将提供杠杆 (leverage) 的加密交易所纳入联邦监管，开启60天公众意见征询。此举是CLARITY法案在参议院受阻后，监管机构依据现有职权自行推进市场结构规则的标志性动作。纯现货 (spot) 交易所不在覆盖范围。
summary.en: The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission published an advance notice of proposed rulemaking on October 5, outlining Regulation CTX and Regulation CAM to bring crypto exchanges offering leveraged trading under federal oversight, opening a 60-day comment period. The move marks regulators filling the market-structure gap with existing authority after the CLARITY Act stalled in the Senate. Plain spot exchanges are left outside the framework.

title.zh: SOL守住120美元；SOL ETF单周流入243万美元，机构需求降温
title.en: SOL Holds $120 as SOL ETF Inflows Cool to $2.43M

summary.zh: SOL维持在120美元附近交投。SoSoValue数据显示，SOL现货ETF上周净流入243万美元，远低于前一周的1.88亿美元，不过仍实现连续第14周净流入。数字资产财库公司DeFi Development (DFDV) 增持26,203枚SOL，财库价值约3.02亿美元。
summary.en: SOL traded near $120. SoSoValue data showed SOL-focused ETFs drew just $2.43 million in weekly net inflows, down sharply from $188.22 million the prior week, though the streak of positive weeks reached 14. Digital-asset treasury firm DeFi Development (DFDV) added 26,203 SOL, bringing its treasury to about $302 million.

Ethereum's Glamsterdam upgrade activates on the Sepolia testnet today at 13:53 UTC (epoch 353,024). Headline changes: enshrined proposer-builder separation (ePBS, EIP-7732) and block-level access lists (BALs, EIP-7928). Mainnet targeting Q4 2026; no action needed from ETH holders.
summary.zh: 以太坊Glamsterdam升级今日13:53 UTC在Sepolia测试网 (testnet) 激活（epoch 353024）。核心改动：写入协议的提议者-构建者分离 (ePBS, EIP-7732) 与区块级访问清单 (BALs, EIP-7928)。主网目标2026年Q4，ETH持有者无需操作。

title.en: Ethereum's Glamsterdam Upgrade Activates on Sepolia Testnet Today
title.zh: 以太坊Glamsterdam升级今日在Sepolia测试网激活
Solana Foundation推出Solana DvP：摩根大通参与设计的机构级链上券款对付 (DvP) 结算标准
title.en: Solana Foundation Launches Solana DvP, Institutional On-Chain Settlement Standard Shaped with J.P. Morgan

summary.zh: Solana Foundation今日发布Solana DvP，一个MIT开源的链上托管程序 (escrow program)，为金融机构提供标准化的原子化券款对付 (Delivery-versus-Payment, DvP) 结算接口。摩根大通 (J.P. Morgan) 在开发过程中就机构结算实践与合规需求提供了输入。该标准将传统需数日的清算流程压缩为一笔原子交易，资产与资金要么同时交割、要么都不交割，数秒内完成最终结算。
summary.en: The Solana Foundation today launched Solana DvP, an MIT-licensed open-source escrow program offering financial institutions a standardized API for atomic delivery-versus-payment settlement on Solana. J.P. Morgan provided input on institutional settlement practices and requirements during development. The standard compresses a traditionally multi-day clearing process into a single atomic transaction — asset and payment settle together or not at all, with finality in seconds.

U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs posted $241M in net inflows last week, the third consecutive week of gains led by BlackRock's IBIT ($450M). Total net assets across spot BTC ETFs reached $108.89B, signaling renewed institutional demand.
summary.zh: 美国比特币现货ETF (Spot ETF) 上周净流入2.41亿美元，连续第三周录得增长，其中贝莱德IBIT贡献4.5亿美元。目前现货BTC ETF总净资产达1088.9亿美元，显示机构需求回暖。

title.en: Spot Bitcoin ETFs Post $241M Inflows, Third Straight Week of Gains
title.zh: 比特币现货ETF单周净流入2.41亿美元，连续第三周增长

summary.en: Solana's Alpenglow upgrade achieved 54ms median finalization on testnet, beating design targets and moving closer to mainnet activation — a major leap for network speed and scalability.
summary.zh: Solana的Alpenglow升级在测试网实现54毫秒中位确认时间 (finality)，超设计目标，主网激活渐近——网络速度与可扩展性迎来大跃升。

title.en: Solana's Alpenglow Hits 54ms Finality on Testnet
title.zh: Solana Alpenglow测试网实现54毫秒确认，超设计目标

summary.en: ETH trades near $2,712 (+0.7% / 24h). U.S. spot Ether ETFs saw ~$118M net outflows last week after $689.8M inflows the week before. BitMine reports 6,001,302 ETH holdings; its next weekly update lands Monday.
summary.zh: ETH报2712美元附近（24小时+0.7%）。美国以太坊现货ETF上周净流出约1.18亿美元，前一周曾流入6.898亿美元。BitMine持有600万枚ETH，下一次持仓周报将于周一公布。

title.en: ETH Near $2,712 as Spot Ether ETFs See $118M Weekly Outflows
title.zh: ETH守住2712美元，以太坊现货ETF周流出1.18亿美元

summary.en: The CFTC chair named SOL among digital commodities under CFTC oversight, easing regulatory uncertainty. Separately, Fiserv launched its digital-asset platform on Solana, with 90+ North Dakota banks using Roughrider Coin for interbank settlement.
summary.zh: CFTC主席将SOL列为其监管的数字商品 (digital commodity)，监管不确定性下降。另，Fiserv在Solana上推出数字资产平台，90多家北达科他州银行已用Roughrider Coin做银行间结算。

title.en: SOL Classed as Digital Commodity; Fiserv Brings 90+ U.S. Banks to Solana
title.zh: SOL被列为数字商品；Fiserv携90余家美国银行登陆Solana

summary.en: A vault on Base lost 1,783 wstETH (~$6M) on Sunday after an attacker was added to its whitelist, borrowed receipt tokens and redeemed via Aave V3. Neither Base nor Aave core contracts were compromised — an access-control failure on the vault's multisig.
summary.zh: Base上一金库周日损失1783枚wstETH（约600万美元）：攻击者被加入白名单 (whitelist) 后借出凭证代币并经Aave V3赎回。Base与Aave核心合约未受影响，系金库多签 (multisig) 的访问控制失误。

title.en: Base Vault Loses $6M in wstETH Whitelist Exploit
title.zh: Base金库遭白名单攻击，损失600万美元wstETH

summary.en: Solana's spot DEX volume topped Ethereum mainnet, all its L2s, and Hyperliquid combined to open Q4 — over $1.6B per Blockworks data. 21Shares research: Solana handled 36%+ of global spot DEX volume in H1 2026, roughly double Ethereum's share.
summary.zh: Solana现货DEX交易量在Q4开局超过以太坊主网+全部L2+Hyperliquid之和（Blockworks数据超16亿美元）。21Shares研究显示2026上半年Solana处理了全球现货DEX交易量的36%以上，约为以太坊的两倍。

title.en: Solana DEX Volume Flips Ethereum to Open Q4
title.zh: Solana DEX交易量反超以太坊，强势开启Q4

summary.en: Michael Saylor posted 'more orange than ever' on Sunday, hinting at another Strategy bitcoin purchase — typically confirmed in Monday SEC filings. Strategy's last disclosed holding: 847,666 BTC at an average cost of ~$75,437.
summary.zh: Michael Saylor周日发文"more orange than ever"，暗示Strategy将再次增持比特币 (通常于周一SEC文件中确认）。Strategy目前持有847,666枚BTC，平均成本约75,437美元。

title.en: Saylor Hints at New Strategy Bitcoin Purchase
title.zh: Saylor暗示Strategy将再次增持比特币

summary.en: On Oct 2 the SEC approved a Cboe BZX rule change allowing six 3x leveraged ETFs from Volatility Shares — covering bitcoin, ether, gold, silver, oil and gas. The first 3x crypto ETFs in the U.S.; trading still needs S-1 effectiveness. Bloomberg's Eric Balchunas called it 'a big win.'
summary.zh: SEC于10月2日批准Cboe BZX规则变更，允许Volatility Shares发行六只3倍杠杆ETF (Leveraged ETF)，覆盖比特币、以太坊、黄金、白银、原油、天然气——美国首批3倍加密ETF。实际交易仍需S-1生效。彭博Eric Balchunas称之为"重大胜利"。

title.en: SEC Approves First 3x Bitcoin and Ether ETFs in the U.S.
title.zh: SEC批准美国首批3倍比特币/以太坊ETF

summary.en: Veteran trader Peter Brandt has flipped bullish, saying 'there's a good possibility we have seen the low.' He now targets $300,000–$600,000 for Bitcoin's late-2029 cycle peak, up from $250,000–$300,000 in July.
summary.zh: 资深交易员Peter Brandt转多，称"低点可能已经出现"。他将本轮周期比特币顶部目标上调至30万–60万美元（2029年末），高于7月预测的25万–30万美元。

title.en: Peter Brandt Flips Bullish, Sees Bitcoin $300K–$600K by 2029
title.zh: Peter Brandt转多：比特币2029年或达30万–60万美元

summary.en: Bitcoin held above $86,000 on Monday after weak U.S. jobs data pared bets on an October Fed rate hike. $87,000 remains the key resistance; a break could open the path toward $90,000. The Fed publishes September meeting minutes on Wednesday, and TOKEN2049 Singapore runs Oct 7–8.
summary.zh: 受美国疲软就业数据打压10月加息预期影响，比特币周一守住86000美元上方。87000美元仍是关键阻力位 (resistance)，突破后有望看向90000美元。美联储 (Fed) 将于周三公布9月会议纪要，TOKEN2049新加坡大会于10月7–8日举行。

title.en: Bitcoin Holds Above $86K, Tests $87K Resistance Ahead of Fed Minutes
title.zh: 比特币守住86000美元上方，87000美元阻力位成焦点，美联储会议纪要将至

summary.en: Evernorth is set to debut on Nasdaq as XRPN after shareholders approved its merger, expecting to hold ~473M XRP as the largest listed pure-play XRP treasury — the latest in the digital-asset treasury (DAT) trend.
summary.zh: Evernorth在股东批准合并后将以代码XRPN登陆纳斯达克，预计持有约4.73亿枚XRP，成为最大上市XRP财库公司——数字资产财库 (DAT) 热潮的又一案例。

title.en: Evernorth XRP Treasury to Debut on Nasdaq as XRPN
title.zh: Evernorth XRP财库即将以XRPN登陆纳斯达克

summary.en: With the U.S. federal budget lapsed, the SEC has halted reviews of new crypto ETF applications — 90+ were pending as October began. Existing products (IBIT, FBTC) trade normally. Analysts call the 'ETF Cryptober' delay temporary, not a rejection.
summary.zh: 因美国联邦预算中断，SEC已暂停新的加密货币ETF申请审核——10月初有90多份申请待批。已上市产品（IBIT、FBTC）交易不受影响。分析师称"ETF Cryptober"只是推迟而非否决。

title.en: SEC Funding Lapse Halts New Crypto ETF Reviews
title.zh: SEC资金中断，暂停新的加密货币ETF审核
